title: Telehealth to Improve Quality of Life in Persons Living in Rural Texas
official: Improving Quality of Life in Persons Living in Rural Texas
summary: The overarching goal of this project is to evaluate a current evidence-based practice, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, for mental health conditions against Cognitive Behavioral Therapy plus two check-in calls a week for adults living in rural Texas.

interventions.name: Cognitive Behavioral therapy with 2 check in calls

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* family caregiver of person with all forms of dementia

Exclusion Criteria:

* not in another clinical intervention
